beats.text: RLHF is a brittle, multi-stage beast; you're forced to fit a reward model, sample endlessly, and tune unstable reinforcement hyperparameters.
beats.visual_focus: An optimization landscape with an unstable path crashing into a barrier.

beats.text: DPO bypasses the theater by mapping reward functions directly to optimal policies through a single, closed-form objective on preference data.
beats.visual_focus: A convergence funnel showing disparate preferences condensing into one model weights update.

beats.text: By formulating alignment as a classification problem, we eliminate sampling loops and gradient drift that normally plague standard RLHF tuning cycles.
beats.visual_focus: A pipeline stage diagram showing the transition from classification to tuned weights.

beats.text: Empirical results confirm DPO matches or exceeds PPO's summarization quality while requiring zero external reinforcement learning overhead or reward modeling.
